mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite strong GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low FEDFUNDS rate (< 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 6% signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite falling unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals strengthening industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 55% of triggered late-cycle instances despite strong industrial production growth.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of RSAFS and HOUST, where both increase by more than 5% YoY, signals broadening demand strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC of the joint signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in FEDFUNDS by more than 0.5% in 2 months signals impending monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 45% of triggered tightening instances despite rapid rate hikes.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: PAYEMS growth outpacing UNRATE decline by more than 2:1 ratio over the last quarter signals labor market resilience, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC of the labor resilience signal remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding a 3-month average of 250 signals heightened inflation concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered tightening instances despite high inflation signals.
